article.detail:
Peec AI於10月30日宣布完成SOC 2 Type II審查，稱由Prescient Assurance檢視安全控制的實際運作。

觀察期為2026年3月30日至6月30日。

公司列出的企業功能包括SAML單一登入、角色權限及API與MCP接入。

評估AI搜尋量度供應商時，可把資料安全與量度準確性分開審查。

索取正式報告及適用範圍，另以品牌樣本驗收量度結果。

本刊只閱讀公司公告，未取得完整審查報告；這不證明量度準確、零風險或所有法規合規。
article.detail_en:
Peec AI announced on October 30 that Prescient Assurance completed a SOC 2 Type II examination of its security controls.

The observation period ran March 30–June 30, 2026.

Listed enterprise features include SAML SSO, role permissions, API access and MCP.

AI-search vendor evaluation should assess data controls separately from measurement accuracy.

Request the report and scope, then separately validate measurements against brand samples.

Only the company release was inspected, not the full report. It establishes no measurement accuracy, zero-risk or universal legal compliance.
